description: Look up an IP address or CIDR block via RIR RDAP (ARIN, RIPE, APNIC, LACNIC, AFRINIC — auto-routed via IANA bootstrap). Returns netblock, org, country, all provider CIDRs, abuse contact email, and reverse DNS (PTR) via DoH. PTR status distinguishes found, not_found, and failed with ptr_source_error. Alias traversal is limited to five transitions under one DNS deadline. The base address is queried for CIDR input. The server excludes IPv4 0/8, 10/8, 100.64/10, 127/8, 169.254/16, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 255/8 and IPv6 ::1/128, fc00::/7, fe80::/10. Other special-use addresses remain eligible for lookup. include_routing optionally adds RIPEstat RIS-observed prefix and all origin ASNs for whois_lookup_asn; routing observations use eight-hour dumps and are separate from registry ownership. Optional failure retains RDAP/PTR.

include_routing.description: Add separately attributed RIS routing observations under one 3000 ms deadline. Omitted/false makes no routing request; no ASN-detail lookups are performed.

ip.description: IPv4 address (e.g., "8.8.8.8"), IPv6 address (e.g., "2001:4860:4860::8888"), or CIDR notation (e.g., "192.0.2.0/24"). One decimal prefix in 0–32 (IPv4) or 0–128 (IPv6); no whitespace, zone IDs, or brackets. IPv4-mapped IPv6 uses its embedded IPv4 for lookup and PTR.

name: whois_lookup_ip

cidr.description: Provider CIDR only when the allocation has exactly one component.

cidrs.description: All provider CIDR components in upstream order; empty when absent.

country.description: Country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Omitted when not in RDAP data.

end_address.description: End address of the IP netblock.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `ip_no_rdap_route`: A successfully loaded IANA bootstrap has no covering RIR route. `invalid_ip`: Input is not a valid IPv4, IPv6, or CIDR address. `private_range`: The numeric address falls within the server’s explicit excluded ranges. `ip_not_found`: RIR RDAP returned 404 — no netblock record for this address. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

name.description: Network name assigned by the RIR.

ptr.description: Reverse DNS hostname (PTR record). Null when PTR lookup fails, returns no answer, or domain is NXDOMAIN.

ptr_source_error.description: PTR failure explanation; RDAP data remains usable.

ptr_status.description: PTR outcome: matching hostname, successful absence, or failed resolver/alias traversal.

rdap_source.description: RIR that provided the RDAP data (ARIN, RIPE, APNIC, LACNIC, AFRINIC).

routing.description: Routing detail only when include_routing is enabled; separate from registry ownership.

next_tool.description: Use this tool with an origin_asns value to retrieve ASN details.

origin_asns.description: All observed origin ASNs in provider order, directly accepted by whois_lookup_asn.

prefix.description: RIS-observed containing prefix, independent of registry allocation CIDRs; null on absence/failure.

recovery.description: How to retry optional routing after a failure.

snapshot_basis.description: RIS eight-hour dump basis and ownership distinction.

source.description: RIPEstat Network Info data source URL.

source_error.description: Optional routing failure explanation; RDAP and PTR remain usable.

status.description: RIS observation found, successful absence, or optional upstream failure.

start_address.description: Start address of the IP netblock.

title: IP Address / Network Lookup
